name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with your feet firmly anchored (partner, bench, or foot hooks).
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to head — hips extended.
Lower yourself slowly toward the floor, resisting with the hamstrings.
Go as far as you can control, catch yourself with your hands, and push back up.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: An advanced bodyweight hinge-pattern exercise for the hamstrings. Nordic Hamstring Curl builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
